The first public release of **FilaSignal**, a Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.3 that adds programmable computers and
hardware, scripted in **FilaScript**, its own small event-driven language.

## Highlights

- **Programmable Computer** with an in-game editor: syntax highlighting, completion, starter programs, validation
  before saving, and a debugger with breakpoints, stepping, variables and a console.
- **FilaScript**: functions with multiple return values, lists, dictionaries, classes, enums, JSON, error values and
  persistent `global` variables, with clear line-and-column diagnostics.
- **Fourteen hardware blocks**: entity detectors, displays, alarms, redstone controllers, inventory modules, weather
  stations, environment sensors, storage servers, access controllers, control panels, wireless bridges, repeaters
  and more, linked with the Linking Tool.
- **Native events**: `on gate.entityEnter(entity)`, `on sky.rainStart()`, `on panel.buttonOne(player)`, plus custom
  events between programs with server-verified senders.
- **Autonomous devices**: a Programmable Data Drive lets a device run its own program and keep its own storage.
- **Networks and storage**: repeaters, wireless bridges, device names, drive storage and shared Storage Servers.
- **Built for servers**: owners and trusted players, server-side checks on every request, and strict per-handler
  and per-tick limits so programs cannot stall a server.
- **Survival**: recipes for every block and item, original textures and models.

## Install

Requires Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.20.1 or newer, Fabric API 0.166.2+26.3 or newer and Java 25.

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) for 26.3.
2. Put `filasignal-1.0.0+mc26.3.jar` (below) and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) into `mods`.
3. On a server, every player needs the same FilaSignal version.

Then follow [Your first automation](https://venuss1337.github.io/filasignal/minecraft/getting-started/first-automation/).

## Standalone FilaScript

`filascript-cli-1.0.0.zip` runs FilaScript programs without Minecraft (Java 25):
`bin/filascript-cli run examples/hello.fsig`. See the
[language documentation](https://venuss1337.github.io/filasignal/language/).

## Known limitations

- Minecraft 26.3 with Fabric only.
- The bundled LibGui is a release-candidate build for 26.3 (`18.0.1+26.3-rc-2`).
- At most 16 fresh entity scans run per server tick across all detectors; extra scans in the same tick return
  `detector.busy`.
- The editor wraps long lines; there is no horizontal scrolling.
